text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus looked up to the tokusatsu 
hero Carrotman, admiring his indomitable 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus's dream was to win races and 
become a hero just like Carrotman.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus's aptitudes ranged from short 
distance to the mile, with her explosive 
burst of speed being her greatest weapon. 
However, sprint races were packed with 
heavily muscled Umamusume, putting her 
petite frame at a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, her preferred tactic was 
surging from behind. On the final stretch, 
she would inevitably have to break through 
a dense wall of muscle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Undaunted by such hardships and cheered on 
by her roommate, Hishi Akebono, Biko 
Pegasus kept looking forward. Her path to 
becoming the ultimate hero had only just 
begun.
